messages:
maya: quick flag — examples/embeddings/README.md still shows an old import `from redwood_client import EmbeddingClient`. New SDK uses `redwood` package now and constructor arg changed.

sam: Ah, that will break the first-run experience. Paste the snippet you saw?

maya: ```python
from redwood_client import EmbeddingClient
client = EmbeddingClient(api_key=\"<KEY>\")
```

maya: should be:```python
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient(api_key_or_token=\"${REDWOOD_API_KEY}\")
```

liam: Good catch. Can we also add a one-line safety note at the top: "Use env vars like ${REDWOOD_API_KEY} instead of pasting secrets into examples." New hires keep copying keys into code.

jordan: I'll open a tiny PR: fix the Python snippet, sync the JS sample (I saw a `RedwoodClient` -> should be `Redwood`), and add a lightweight GitHub Actions smoke test that runs `python -c \"import redwood\"` in the examples folder. Matrix: 3.9 and 3.11.

sam: Make the action only trigger on changes under /examples/** and on PRs/push to main so CI doesn't explode.

docs: please add a changelog line under docs/quickstart and tag onboarding/docs:urgent so training docs get updated.

jordan: Also propose a tiny change to the sample PR template: a checkbox that asks authors to run the smoke test or add one. Prevents regressions.

maya: When you open the PR, title it: "fix: sample import + smoke test" and ping this thread. We'll fast-track. :thumbsup:
